hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom AMM hook that routes swaps entirely through Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes using a concentration-curve invariant, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another, and verifies the resulting reserves satisfy the curve before returning a full BeforeSwapDelta. Standard Uniswap v4 liquidity positions are intentionally blocked.
